**Welcome to episode 001 of GripeCast.** Listen to Founder of Techaeris Alex Hernandez Gripe about technology and culture. **This is the MeWe EXCLUSIVE version of GripeCast and this audience is the first to get it.**

In this episode,

1. Apple Vision Pro — What are my thoughts?
2. Smart TV's — Why do they not have more storage for files?
3.HP Printers and Ink — Why are they sabotaging their own business?
4. Foldable Displays and the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Fold 16 — What are my thoughts?
5. Roku Terms of Service — What's going on there?
6. MeWe EXCLUSIVE Content — Social Media, what do I want out of it? What do you want out of it?

As always, thank you for checking out our website for tech reviews and news!
Check it out here! https://techaeris.com/

In January we spotlighted **TECHAERIS**, a technology focused page run by longtime MeWe member Alex Hernandez. He has now launched his first ever podcast, GripeCast where he shares his thoughts on technology and culture. The pilot episode features a segment about MeWe and we’d love for you all to support the show. It’s a great listen!

Hello MeWe community,

As the presidential election draws near we wanted to take a moment to share our experiences from the past election cycle. On two separate occasions we had our distribution partners remove MeWe from their app stores due to members who violated our Community Guidelines.

***As a reminder, here’s an overview:***

- Respect others in our community
- Don’t violate any laws
- Don’t Troll or harass others
- Don’t pretend to be someone else
- Don’t post content that you don’t have the rights to
- Don’t post anything that you know to be false
- Don’t assume you’re right and everyone else is wrong

In short, we do not care what your politics are but you do need to be nice and to respect each other.

Starting tomorrow and in the coming weeks we’ll be posting polls asking how you feel about politics on MeWe. Please take a moment to have your voices heard.

Let’s work together to build a great community that’s a social network for everyone.

Hello MeWe community!

I’m excited to share something HUGE coming next week, MeWe is opening a community investment round!

More than 20 million people have already joined us in building the privacy-first, user-focused alternative to Big Tech social media. Our community is expanding rapidly, and more and more of you are migrating to the Social Web every day to enjoy even greater control and ownership over your MeWe experience.

To fuel this growth, we are raising capital and offering you the opportunity to purchase MeWe stock on Wefunder so that our community can invest directly in our mission to create the ultimate decentralized social media experience.

MeWe Premium members will be among the first to receive exclusive access to the community investment round including VIP investment terms in appreciation for our power users and those who are already driving our revenue growth.

Not a member? Head to the MeWe Store and sign up for MeWe Premium to be among the first to participate!

Thank you so much for being a part of our journey. We’ll be in touch with more details soon.

All the best,
Jeffrey Edell
CEO & Chairman

Dear MeWe Community,

Our community investment round on Wefunder is coming to a close. Thank you to the many MeWe users who have joined us so far! If you've been waiting to invest, I encourage you to come on board as a MeWe shareholder today.

As I reflect on what we are trying to accomplish in this seminal moment, I want to reinforce why MeWe is essential to our world. There must be an alternative to Big Tech social media that puts users first. There must be a safe place online where people can control and own their data, as it is not for Big tech to exploit. Where we can ensure that people on the web are real and not bots. Where we respect people’s privacy, and where we can positively impact society and eliminate information manipulation. MeWe is that place.

By engaging on MeWe, as well as investing in our mission, you can take a stance against Big Tech and signal that you want control back. You want ownership.

That’s what this community investment round is all about. We want to give power back to our users and give you a chance to own a personal stake in MeWe, a platform that champions community interests over those of corporations, advertisers, or data brokers. With over 20 million users worldwide and growing, our commitment to building a truly decentralized social network has never been stronger.

I hope you’ll consider joining your fellow MeWe community members as owners and shareholders of MeWe. If you've already invested, it’s not too late to increase your stake.

Exciting times ahead for MeWe! 🚀 I’m happy to share my latest article with Rolling Stone, discussing the evolution of social media and the movement towards decentralization. Frank McCourt, our partner and investor, has been instrumental in this vision. His commitment to decentralized social media aligns perfectly with our mission at MeWe.

We are focused on empowering users, enhancing privacy, and fostering genuine connections. As part of McCourt’s Project Liberty, we’ve started migrating to the decentralized Frequency blockchain, with over 930,000 active users on-chain. Notably, 368,000 users have claimed their social graph. While there are challenges, this move promises a return to the true roots of social connectivity. Together, let’s continue building a privacy-first, community-focused social network.
